text:
Alex Kim: Seeing high packet loss and timeouts between ml-prod pods in us-west-2. Several GPU training pods failing with 'connection reset by peer'. Any recent network changes? :fire:
infra-bot: Alert: Pod networking errors spike in namespace ml-prod (5m avg packet loss 27%).
Maria Gonzalez: Are we seeing any NetworkPolicy changes? I think we merged an isolation policy yesterday.
Shawn Patel: Running quick checks — `kubectl exec` between two pods on different nodes shows 40% packet loss, same-node is fine. Pulling NetworkPolicy now.
Shawn Patel: Command: ```kubectl get networkpolicy -n ml-prod -o yaml``` Output (trimmed):
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-namespaced
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
  namespaceSelector:
    matchLabels:
      isolation: 'true'
```
Jess Liu: That `egress: []` + namespaceSelector will block all egress to other namespaces unless explicitly allowed. Classic namespace isolation got applied cluster-wide in ml-prod. That would break east-west calls.
Dan O'Neill: Oh — that was from PR #482 (infra-hardening). We intended a more restrictive scope but it hit ml-prod.
Maria Gonzalez: Quick mitigation: add an explicit egress rule to allow namespaces with label `allow-east-west: true` and allow kube-system and infra teams.
Shawn Patel: Patch applied (one-liner):
```
kubectl patch networkpolicy deny-egress-namespaced -n ml-prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/egress","value":[{"to":[{"namespaceSelector":{"matchLabels":{"allow-east-west":"true"}}}],"ports":[{"protocol":"TCP"}]}]}'
```
infra-bot: Config change recorded: networkpolicy/deny-egress-namespaced patched by Dan O'Neill.
oncall-sre: Running connectivity smoke tests across 20 pods (cross-node + cross-az) — ETA ~2m.
oncall-sre: Smoke tests: pod-to-pod latency dropped from ~120ms to ~8-12ms, packet loss down to ~0.5%.
Alex Kim: Training jobs resumed and started making progress. Thanks for the quick rollback/patch.
Jess Liu: Post-incident action items: add a policy label gating doc, update PR checklist to require explicit egress exceptions for internal namespaces, and add an automated test that verifies pod-to-pod connectivity for critical namespaces after policy changes.
Maria Gonzalez: Also flagging MTU fragmentation logs I saw on one host (small). Not the root cause here after the patch, but note for follow-up. For RDMA/RoCE nodes: networkpolicy/eip-like rules can silently disrupt non-TCP flows — add a checklist item for RDMA-enabled clusters.
Dan O'Neill: I'll open the incident write-up and link PR #482, include timeline.
Alex Kim: I'll take owner for follow-up and ensure the docs + CI tests land this sprint.
